item: Elections calendar: the #1773 follow-ups (narrow shadowing, alpha-3 meets alpha-2, Wikidata time values)
summary: layer() shadows a snapshot row only when a dated curated entry of the same country, agreeing office and overlapping year or month covers it, with the reason recorded; both sides of layer() and the tier report go through config_country; Wikidata sign and time parts are stripped and 00 parts read only under a coarser precision; the no-score test walks every key.
